note: Design v4 section 9c: once per round, before any doll's turn, Wren may use ONE free hand action. At fear 50+ his hands shake and the attempt fails on a seeded 1..25 of 100; a failed attempt still spends the round's hand action.

actions.name: Steady
actions.text: Wren cups one doll in both hands until its stitching stops trembling.

actions.name: Shield the Candle
actions.text: Wren curls a hand around the flame: this round the candle's darkness leaves the dolls alone.

actions.name: Hold Back
actions.text: Wren pinches one doll's string tight: this round it cannot be moved, shoved or pulled.

actions.name: Lift
actions.text: Wren lifts one doll a single rank forward or back without spending its turn; never across a snipped thread.
